ZWE.name: Zimbabwe
ZWE.landmark: Formerly Rhodesia; named after the great medieval stone city whose ruins stand here
funFacts: Its central bank once printed a 100-trillion-dollar note
It shares Victoria Falls with Zambia

ZMB.name: Zambia
ZMB.landmark: Formerly Northern Rhodesia; the heart of Africa's Copperbelt
funFacts: It shares Victoria Falls with Zimbabwe
Lake Kariba, shared with Zimbabwe, is the largest artificial lake by volume
Its South Luangwa park is famous for walking safaris

YEM.name: Yemen
YEM.landmark: Shibam's mud-brick skyscrapers and Socotra's dragon blood trees
funFacts: Mocha coffee is named after its port of al-Makha
The Queen of Sheba's kingdom is linked to its ancient Saba
Its old capital's tower houses are decorated with white gypsum

VNM.name: Vietnam
VNM.landmark: The limestone islands of Ha Long Bay
funFacts: It is the world's second-largest coffee exporter
Son Doong is the largest known cave in the world
Pho, a noodle soup, is its national dish

VEN.name: Venezuela
VEN.landmark: Angel Falls, the world's highest uninterrupted waterfall
funFacts: It has the largest proven oil reserves in the world
Lightning strikes almost every night over Lake Maracaibo
Its name means "little Venice"

VAT.name: Vatican City
funFacts: It is the smallest country in the world
The Swiss Guard has protected it since 1506
Michelangelo painted the Sistine Chapel ceiling here

UZB.name: Uzbekistan
funFacts: It is one of only two doubly landlocked countries in the world
Its Silk Road cities include Bukhara and Khiva
The Aral Sea on its border has mostly dried up

URY.name: Uruguay
URY.landmark: Won the first FIFA World Cup, as host, in 1930
funFacts: It was the first country to fully legalize cannabis, in 2013
It has more cows than people
Its people drink mate from gourds everywhere they go

USA.name: United States
USA.landmark: The Statue of Liberty and the Grand Canyon
funFacts: Its flag has 50 stars, one for each state
Yellowstone was the world's first national park, in 1872
It has the world's largest economy

SHN.name: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha

ARE.name: United Arab Emirates
ARE.landmark: The Burj Khalifa, the world's tallest building
funFacts: It is a federation of seven emirates formed in 1971
Its Palm Jumeirah is an artificial island shaped like a palm tree
Its Ferrari World theme park has one of the fastest roller coasters on Earth

UKR.name: Ukraine
funFacts: It is the largest country entirely within Europe
Its Antonov An-225 was the largest plane ever built
Its flag's blue and yellow stand for sky and wheat fields

UGA.name: Uganda
UGA.landmark: The White Nile begins its journey at Jinja
funFacts: About half of the world's mountain gorillas live in its Bwindi forest
Winston Churchill called it the Pearl of Africa
Lake Victoria takes up a large part of its south

TKM.name: Turkmenistan
TKM.landmark: The Darvaza gas crater, nicknamed the "Door to Hell"
funFacts: Its Karakum Desert covers about 70% of the country
Akhal-Teke horses, with metallic shining coats, are a national symbol

TUR.name: Turkey
TUR.landmark: Hagia Sophia and Cappadocia's hot-air balloons
funFacts: Its largest city straddles two continents across the Bosphorus
Santa Claus's inspiration, St Nicholas, was a bishop in its town of Myra
Tulips were brought to the Netherlands from here

TUN.name: Tunisia
TUN.landmark: The ruins of Carthage and the desert sets of Star Wars' Tatooine
funFacts: The amphitheater of El Jem is one of the largest Roman arenas
The 2011 Arab Spring began here
Its Matmata troglodyte homes are dug into the ground

TGO.name: Togo
TGO.landmark: One of Africa's narrowest countries, with about 50 km of coast between Ghana and Benin
funFacts: Its Koutammakou landscape has fortress-like mud tower houses
Its football star Emmanuel Adebayor played for Arsenal
Its capital is the only capital in the world right on an international border

THA.name: Thailand
THA.landmark: The Emerald Buddha in the Grand Palace; the only Southeast Asian country never colonized
funFacts: Its capital's full ceremonial name is the longest place name in the world
The "art of eight limbs", a kickboxing style using fists, elbows, knees and shins, comes from here
Songkran, the new year festival, is a giant nationwide water fight

TZA.name: Tanzania
TZA.landmark: Mount Kilimanjaro and the spice island of Zanzibar
funFacts: Freddie Mercury was born on its island of Zanzibar

Lake Victoria, Lake Tanganyika and Lake Malawi all touch it

TJK.name: Tajikistan
TJK.landmark: The Pamir Highway; over 90% of the land is mountains
funFacts: Its Fedchenko Glacier is one of the longest glaciers outside the polar regions
Its Rogun Dam is set to be the tallest dam in the world
Its main language is closely related to Persian

SYR.name: Syria
SYR.landmark: The ancient desert city of Palmyra
funFacts: Its capital is often called the oldest continuously inhabited capital in the world
Aleppo soap, made with olive and laurel oil, comes from here
The Krak des Chevaliers is one of the best-preserved Crusader castles

CHE.name: Switzerland
CHE.landmark: The Red Cross was founded here; famous for neutrality, banks and watches
funFacts: It has four national languages
CERN's Large Hadron Collider runs beneath its border with France
The Matterhorn rises on its border with Italy

SWE.name: Sweden
SWE.landmark: Home of IKEA, ABBA and the Ice Hotel at Jukkasjärvi
funFacts: The Nobel Prizes are awarded in its capital
Spotify was founded here in 2006
It has more islands than any other country, around 267,000

SWZ.name: Eswatini
SWZ.landmark: Formerly Swaziland; one of the world's last absolute monarchies
funFacts: The Umhlanga Reed Dance gathers tens of thousands of young women each year
It is one of the smallest countries in Africa

SUR.name: Suriname
SUR.landmark: South America's smallest country; Dutch is the official language
funFacts: More than 90% of the country is covered by rainforest

SSD.name: South Sudan
SSD.landmark: The world's newest country, independent since 2011
funFacts: The Sudd, one of the largest wetlands in the world, covers much of it

SDN.name: Sudan
SDN.landmark: More ancient pyramids than Egypt, at Meroë

ESP.name: Spain

KOR.name: South Korea
KOR.landmark: Home of K-pop, Samsung and Hyundai
funFacts: It hosted the Summer Olympics in 1988 and the Winter Olympics in 2018

Kimchi, fermented cabbage, is its national side dish

ZAF.name: South Africa
ZAF.landmark: Table Mountain and Robben Island, where Nelson Mandela was imprisoned
funFacts: It has three capital cities, one for each branch of government
It has 12 official languages

SOM.name: Somalia
SOM.landmark: The longest coastline of any country in mainland Africa, on the Horn of Africa
funFacts: Its camel herd is the largest in the world

SVK.name: Slovakia
SVK.landmark: Spiš Castle, one of the largest castle complexes in Central Europe
funFacts: It has more castles per person than almost any other country

SVN.name: Slovenia
SVN.landmark: Lake Bled and its island church
funFacts: About 60% of the country is covered by forest

SLE.name: Sierra Leone
SLE.landmark: The setting of the "blood diamond" civil war of the 1990s
funFacts: Its name means "lion mountains" in Portuguese
Its capital was founded as a home for freed slaves

SRB.name: Serbia
SRB.landmark: Novak Djokovic's homeland and the EXIT music festival in Novi Sad

SEN.name: Senegal
SEN.landmark: The Pink Lake (Lac Retba) and Gorée Island

SAU.name: Saudi Arabia
SAU.landmark: Mecca and Medina, the holiest cities of Islam

SMR.name: San Marino

RWA.name: Rwanda
RWA.landmark: The "land of a thousand hills"; mountain gorillas in Volcanoes National Park
funFacts: It banned plastic bags in 2008

RUS.name: Russia
RUS.landmark: Red Square and St. Basil's Cathedral
funFacts: It is the largest country in the world, spanning 11 time zones
Lake Baikal holds about a fifth of the world's unfrozen fresh surface water

ROU.name: Romania
ROU.landmark: Bran Castle in Transylvania, linked to the Dracula legend

QAT.name: Qatar

PRT.name: Portugal
PRT.landmark: The Belém Tower, and Cristiano Ronaldo's birthplace

POL.name: Poland
POL.landmark: The Wieliczka Salt Mine and the Auschwitz memorial
funFacts: Marie Curie and Copernicus were both born here

PER.name: Peru
funFacts: The Nazca Lines are giant ancient drawings in its desert

PRY.name: Paraguay
PRY.landmark: Its flag has a different emblem on the front and the back
funFacts: Most of its people speak the Indigenous language Guaraní

PAN.name: Panama

PAK.name: Pakistan

funFacts: K2, the second-highest mountain on Earth, rises on its border

OMN.name: Oman

NOR.name: Norway
NOR.landmark: The fjords of Geirangerfjord and the fishing villages of the Lofoten Islands

PRK.name: North Korea
PRK.landmark: Ruled by three generations of the Kim dynasty under the Juche ideology

NGA.name: Nigeria
NGA.landmark: Africa's most populous country and home of "Nollywood"
funFacts: It has more than 500 languages

NER.name: Niger
NER.landmark: The Aïr Mountains and the Ténéré desert, where the lone "Tree of Ténéré" once stood

NIC.name: Nicaragua
NIC.landmark: Central America's largest country; Ometepe's twin volcanoes rise from its great lake

NLD.name: Netherlands
NLD.landmark: The windmills of Kinderdijk and spring tulip fields
funFacts: About a quarter of the country lies below sea level

NPL.name: Nepal

NAM.name: Namibia

MOZ.name: Mozambique

MAR.name: Morocco

ESH.name: Western Sahara

MNE.name: Montenegro

MNG.name: Mongolia

MDA.name: Moldova

MCO.name: Monaco

MEX.name: Mexico

MRT.name: Mauritania

MLI.name: Mali

MYS.name: Malaysia

MWI.name: Malawi

MKD.name: North Macedonia

LUX.name: Luxembourg

LTU.name: Lithuania

LIE.name: Liechtenstein

LBY.name: Libya
LBY.landmark: Ruled by Muammar Gaddafi for 42 years
funFacts: Over 90% of its land is desert

LBR.name: Liberia
LBR.landmark: Founded by freed American slaves; Africa's oldest republic

LSO.name: Lesotho

LBN.name: Lebanon

LVA.name: Latvia

funFacts: About half the country is covered in forest

LAO.name: Laos

KGZ.name: Kyrgyzstan

funFacts: About 90% of the country is mountainous

KWT.name: Kuwait

UNK.name: Kosovo

KEN.name: Kenya

KAZ.name: Kazakhstan

funFacts: It is the largest landlocked country in the world

JOR.name: Jordan
JOR.landmark: Petra, the rose-red city carved into rock

ITA.name: Italy

ISR.name: Israel
ISR.landmark: The desert fortress of Masada above the Dead Sea

PSE.name: Palestine

IRQ.name: Iraq

IRN.name: Iran

IND.name: India

HUN.name: Hungary

HND.name: Honduras

GUY.name: Guyana

GNB.name: Guinea-Bissau

GIN.name: Guinea

GTM.name: Guatemala

GRC.name: Greece

GHA.name: Ghana

DEU.name: Germany

GMB.name: Gambia

GAB.name: Gabon

FRA.name: France

FIN.name: Finland

ETH.name: Ethiopia

EST.name: Estonia

ERI.name: Eritrea

GNQ.name: Equatorial Guinea

SLV.name: El Salvador

Pupusas, stuffed corn cakes, are its national dish
It is nicknamed the land of volcanoes

EGY.name: Egypt
EGY.landmark: The pyramids of Giza stand here
funFacts: The Suez Canal links the Mediterranean to the Red Sea through it
Almost all of its people live along the Nile and its delta
Abu Simbel's temples were moved block by block to escape a reservoir

ECU.name: Ecuador
ECU.landmark: The Galápagos Islands belong to it
funFacts: It is named after the equator, which runs through it
The summit of Chimborazo is the farthest point from Earth's center
It uses the US dollar as its currency

DJI.name: Djibouti
DJI.landmark: Lake Assal, the lowest point in Africa
funFacts: It hosts military bases of the USA, China, France, Japan and others
It guards the Bab-el-Mandeb strait, a gateway to the Red Sea
Its Lake Abbe is dotted with steaming limestone chimneys

DNK.name: Denmark
DNK.landmark: LEGO bricks were invented here, and Hans Christian Andersen was born here
funFacts: Its red-and-white flag is the oldest national flag still in use
Tivoli Gardens is one of the oldest amusement parks in the world
It has more bicycles than people in its capital

CZE.name: Czechia
CZE.landmark: Pilsner lager was born in its city of Plzeň
funFacts: Its people drink more beer per person than anyone else in the world
The word "robot" comes from one of its writers, Karel Čapek
Its capital's astronomical clock has run since 1410

HRV.name: Croatia
HRV.landmark: The walls of Dubrovnik and the waterfalls of Plitvice Lakes
funFacts: The necktie comes from its soldiers' scarves, the cravat
Dalmatian dogs are named after its Dalmatia region
It reached the FIFA World Cup final in 2018

CIV.name: Ivory Coast
CIV.landmark: The Basilica of Our Lady of Peace, one of the largest churches in the world
funFacts: It is the world's largest producer of cocoa beans
Didier Drogba is said to have helped pause its civil war with a televised plea
Its largest city, Abidjan, was the capital until 1983

CRI.name: Costa Rica
CRI.landmark: Abolished its army in 1948; famous for "pura vida" and cloud forests like Monteverde
funFacts: It holds roughly 5% of the world's biodiversity on a tiny patch of land
Its people call themselves Ticos
Nearly all of its electricity comes from renewable sources

COD.name: DRC
funFacts: It is the largest country in sub-Saharan Africa by area
It holds much of the world's cobalt, used in phone and car batteries
Bonobos live in the wild only here

COG.name: Congo
COG.landmark: Its capital faces Kinshasa across a river: the closest pair of capital cities in the world
funFacts: It was once part of French Equatorial Africa
Odzala-Kokoua National Park is a stronghold of western lowland gorillas
About two-thirds of its land is covered by rainforest

COL.name: Colombia
COL.landmark: The walled old town of Cartagena and the birthplace of Gabriel García Márquez
funFacts: It is the only South American country with both Pacific and Caribbean coasts
Caño Cristales is nicknamed the river of five colors
It is the world's largest producer of emeralds

CHN.name: China
CHN.landmark: The Forbidden City and the Terracotta Army
funFacts: It uses a single time zone despite spanning about five
Paper, printing, gunpowder and the compass were all invented here
Giant pandas live wild only in its mountain forests

MAC.name: Macau
MAC.landmark: The ruined façade of St. Paul's and the world's biggest casino earnings; Portugal handed it back in 1999
funFacts: It is one of the most densely populated places on Earth
Its local cuisine blends Portuguese and Chinese cooking, as in its famous egg tarts
Its 338 m tower hosts one of the highest commercial bungee jumps in the world

HKG.name: Hong Kong
HKG.landmark: The Star Ferry crosses its harbour; Britain handed it back in 1997
funFacts: It has more skyscrapers than any other city in the world
Its Octopus card was one of the first contactless payment cards
Its Tian Tan Buddha is a giant bronze statue on Lantau Island

CHL.name: Chile
CHL.landmark: Easter Island and its moai statues belong to it
funFacts: It is about 4,300 km long but averages only around 175 km wide
The Atacama is one of the driest non-polar deserts on Earth
It recorded the strongest earthquake ever measured, magnitude 9.5 in 1960

TCD.name: Chad
TCD.landmark: The Ennedi Plateau's sandstone arches and the Tibesti Mountains rise from its Sahara
funFacts: Its great lake has shrunk by about 90% since the 1960s
Its Bodélé Depression is the dustiest place on Earth
Zakouma National Park is famed for its recovering elephant herds

CAF.name: Central African Republic
CAF.landmark: Jean-Bédel Bokassa crowned himself emperor here in a lavish 1977 ceremony
funFacts: Dzanga-Sangha Reserve is famous for forest elephants and lowland gorillas
It is landlocked and lies near the very center of the continent
Its flag has four horizontal stripes crossed by a vertical red one

CAN.name: Canada
CAN.landmark: The CN Tower in Toronto and the Rocky Mountain lakes of Banff
funFacts: It has the longest coastline of any country
Basketball was invented by one of its citizens, James Naismith
It has more lakes than the rest of the world combined

CMR.name: Cameroon
CMR.landmark: Nicknamed "Africa in miniature"; Samuel Eto'o's homeland
funFacts: Its highest peak, an active volcano on the coast, is one of the wettest places in Africa
In 1986 a gas eruption at Lake Nyos killed about 1,700 people
Its national football team is nicknamed the Indomitable Lions

KHM.name: Cambodia
KHM.landmark: Angkor Wat, the largest religious monument in the world
funFacts: It is the only country with a building on its national flag
The Tonlé Sap lake reverses its flow each rainy season
The Khmer Rouge regime ruled it from 1975 to 1979

MMR.name: Myanmar
MMR.landmark: The golden Shwedagon Pagoda and the temple plain of Bagan
funFacts: It was called Burma until 1989
Fishermen on Inle Lake row with one leg wrapped around the oar
Its people often wear thanaka, a pale bark paste, on their faces

BDI.name: Burundi
BDI.landmark: The "Urundi" half of the former Belgian territory of Ruanda-Urundi
funFacts: Its royal drummers perform a famous, thunderous drumming tradition
Lake Tanganyika, one of the deepest lakes on Earth, forms much of its western edge
It moved its political capital away from its largest city, on Lake Tanganyika, in 2019

BFA.name: Burkina Faso
BFA.landmark: Hosts FESPACO, Africa's biggest film festival; formerly called Upper Volta
funFacts: Its name means roughly "land of upright people"
The Sindou Peaks are striking rock needles in its southwest
Its Grand Mosque of Bobo-Dioulasso is built of mud brick

BGR.name: Bulgaria
BGR.landmark: The Rila Monastery and the Valley of Roses, source of much of the world's rose oil
funFacts: The Cyrillic script was developed in its medieval First Empire
People here nod to mean no and shake their heads to mean yes
Some of the oldest worked gold in the world was found in its Varna Necropolis

BRA.name: Brazil
BRA.landmark: Christ the Redeemer looks down over Rio de Janeiro
funFacts: It has won the FIFA World Cup a record five times
Most of the Amazon rainforest lies within its borders
It is the only country in the Americas where Portuguese is the main language

BWA.name: Botswana
BWA.landmark: The Okavango Delta floods out into the Kalahari Desert here
funFacts: It has the largest elephant population in Africa
Its Makgadikgadi Pans are among the largest salt flats in the world
It is one of the world's largest producers of diamonds by value

BIH.name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
BIH.landmark: The rebuilt Stari Most bridge arches over the Neretva river in Mostar
funFacts: The assassination that sparked World War I happened in its capital in 1914
It hosted the 1984 Winter Olympics
Its country has three rotating presidents at once

BOL.name: Bolivia
BOL.landmark: The Salar de Uyuni, the world's largest salt flat
funFacts: It has two capitals: one for the government and one in the constitution
Lake Titicaca, shared with Peru, is one of the highest navigable lakes in the world
It still celebrates a Day of the Sea, mourning the coastline it lost in 1884

BTN.name: Bhutan
BTN.landmark: Measures Gross National Happiness; the Tiger's Nest monastery clings to a cliff here
funFacts: It is one of the few carbon-negative countries in the world
Its flag features a white thunder dragon
Television and the internet only arrived in 1999

BEN.name: Benin
BEN.landmark: Formerly the Kingdom of Dahomey, famed for its all-female warrior regiment
funFacts: It is considered the birthplace of Vodun, or voodoo
Ganvié, a whole town on stilts, sits in Lake Nokoué
Its Ouidah was a major port of the Atlantic slave trade

BLZ.name: Belize
BLZ.landmark: The Great Blue Hole, a giant marine sinkhole in the world's second-largest barrier reef
funFacts: It is the only Central American country where English is the official language
It was called British Honduras until 1973
It created the world's first jaguar reserve, Cockscomb Basin

BEL.name: Belgium
BEL.landmark: The Atomium, the Manneken Pis statue and the headquarters of the European Union
funFacts: It has three official languages: Dutch, French and German
Tintin and the Smurfs were created by its comic artists
It once went 541 days without a government

BLR.name: Belarus
funFacts: Białowieża Forest, home to European bison, straddles its border with Poland
Its land is so flat and wet it is called the land of 10,000 lakes
It was the scene of some of the heaviest losses of World War II

BGD.name: Bangladesh
BGD.landmark: Known as East Pakistan until its 1971 war of independence
funFacts: The Sundarbans, the world's largest mangrove forest, shelter Bengal tigers here
Cox's Bazar is one of the longest natural sea beaches in the world
It is one of the most densely populated large countries on Earth

AZE.name: Azerbaijan
AZE.landmark: The "Land of Fire": the Flame Towers and the ever-burning hillside of Yanar Dag
funFacts: It has about half of the world's mud volcanoes
Its capital, on the Caspian Sea, lies below sea level
It hosted the Eurovision Song Contest in 2012 after winning in 2011

AUT.name: Austria
AUT.landmark: Mozart's birthplace, Salzburg, and the Habsburgs' Schönbrunn Palace
funFacts: The Sound of Music was set and filmed around Salzburg
Arnold Schwarzenegger grew up here
Its capital's coffee house culture is on UNESCO's intangible heritage list

ARM.name: Armenia
ARM.landmark: The first nation to adopt Christianity as its state religion, in 301 AD
funFacts: Mount Ararat, a national symbol, is visible from it but lies across the border in Turkey
Its 39-letter alphabet was created around 405 AD by Mesrop Mashtots
The world's oldest known leather shoe, about 5,500 years old, was found in one of its caves

ARG.name: Argentina
ARG.landmark: Lionel Messi's homeland, where the Perito Moreno Glacier calves into a Patagonian lake
funFacts: Aconcagua, the highest mountain outside Asia, rises in its Andes
The tango was born in the dance halls of its capital's port districts
It has won the FIFA World Cup three times, most recently in 2022

AGO.name: Angola
AGO.landmark: Its oil-rich exclave of Cabinda is cut off from the rest of the country by a strip of the DRC
funFacts: The Kalandula Falls on the Lucala River are among the largest waterfalls in Africa
Its giant sable antelope was feared extinct during the civil war and rediscovered in 2005
It is one of Africa's largest oil producers and a former Portuguese colony

AND.name: Andorra
AND.landmark: A Pyrenean co-principality whose joint heads of state are the French president and a Spanish bishop
funFacts: It has no airport, and Catalan is its only official language
A tiny Pyrenean state famous for duty-free shopping and ski slopes
It has one of the highest life expectancies in the world

DZA.name: Algeria
funFacts: More than 80% of its land is Sahara Desert
The Tassili n'Ajjer plateau has thousands of prehistoric rock paintings
It won independence from France in 1962 after an eight-year war

ALB.name: Albania
ALB.landmark: Its communist ruler Enver Hoxha built over 170,000 concrete bunkers across the land
funFacts: People here traditionally nod to mean no and shake their heads to mean yes
Its flag shows a black double-headed eagle on a red field
It was one of the world's most isolated communist states until 1991

AFG.name: Afghanistan
AFG.landmark: Two giant Buddhas carved into the cliffs of Bamiyan stood here until 2001
funFacts: Its Wakhan Corridor is a thin finger of land reaching out to touch China
Buzkashi, a rough horseback game played with a goat carcass, is the national sport
Most of the world's illicit opium has historically come from its poppy fields
